principle: Use the cheapest/lowest-energy model that meets a measured quality and latency gate; no model receives authority from brand identity.

authority_boundary.deterministic_control: PLC/SCADA and existing plant safety interlocks
authority_boundary.setpoint_or_equipment_changes: operator approval plus deterministic validation required

current_reference_models: Qwen3.8 family; exact size/hardware to be benchmarked locally

proposed_roles.raw_operational_data_policy: REDACTED/AGGREGATED ONLY UNLESS OPERATOR POLICY EXPLICITLY ALLOWS MORE

routing_logic: Routine high-volume tasks -> local efficient model after task-specific benchmark.
Hard anomaly/root-cause reasoning -> primary plus challenger independently.
Safety/equipment recommendation -> deterministic physics/constraint checks plus human operator.
External GPT audit is optional and never required for plant continuity.
Agreement among models does not promote a claim; receipts and measurements do.
Every run logs model family, exact model/version, hardware, prompt/template hash, tool calls, input-data boundary, output, energy if measurable, and operator disposition.
benchmark_requirements: joules per task or joules per token where measurable
note: Model names are a dated implementation snapshot, not a permanent architectural dependency.
